test_classes.description: Verify initial state of a new TravelPlanner instance

tests.name: test_all_fields_none_on_creation
tests.description: All instance variables should be None when TravelPlanner is first created

test_classes.description: Valid inputs to add_trip() should be accepted and stored correctly

tests.name: test_sets_destination
tests.description: destination field should be set to the provided value

tests.name: test_sets_start_date_as_date_object
tests.description: start_date should be stored as a date object, not a string

tests.name: test_sets_end_date_as_date_object
tests.description: end_date should be stored as a date object, not a string

tests.name: test_sets_budget_as_float
tests.description: budget should be stored as a float value

tests.name: test_accepts_integer_budget
tests.description: An integer budget should be accepted and converted to float

tests.name: test_strips_destination_whitespace
tests.description: Leading and trailing whitespace in destination should be stripped

tests.name: test_same_start_and_end_date_allowed
tests.description: A single-day trip where start_date equals end_date should be valid

tests.name: test_prints_success_message
tests.description: A success message containing the destination name should be printed

test_classes.description: Invalid inputs to add_trip() should raise appropriate exceptions

tests.name: test_raises_if_trip_already_exists
tests.description: Adding a second trip without resetting should raise RuntimeError

tests.name: test_raises_on_empty_destination
tests.description: An empty string destination should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_whitespace_destination
tests.description: A whitespace-only destination should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_non_string_destination
tests.description: A non-string destination (e.g. integer) should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_invalid_start_date_format
tests.description: A start_date not in YYYY-MM-DD format should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_invalid_end_date_format
tests.description: An end_date not in YYYY-MM-DD format should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_empty_start_date
tests.description: An empty start_date string should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_when_end_before_start
tests.description: end_date earlier than start_date should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_zero_budget
tests.description: A budget of 0 should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_negative_budget
tests.description: A negative budget should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_string_budget
tests.description: A string budget (e.g. '3500') should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_boolean_budget
tests.description: A boolean budget should raise ValueError (bool is subclass of int in Python)

tests.name: test_state_unchanged_after_failed_add
tests.description: Object state must remain clean if add_trip validation fails

test_classes.description: Verify correct inclusive day count between start and end dates

tests.name: test_multi_day_trip
tests.description: 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-20 inclusive should return 11 days

tests.name: test_single_day_trip
tests.description: Same start and end date should return duration of 1

tests.name: test_month_boundary
tests.description: Trip crossing a month boundary (Jan 30 to Feb 2) should return 4 days

tests.name: test_raises_without_trip
tests.description: Calling calculate_trip_duration() on an empty planner should raise RuntimeError

test_classes.description: Verify budget update behaviour including validation and output

tests.name: test_updates_budget_value
tests.description: Budget should be updated to the new value

tests.name: test_budget_stored_as_float
tests.description: Updated budget should be stored as a float

tests.name: test_prints_old_and_new_budget
tests.description: Console output should show both old and new budget values

tests.name: test_raises_without_trip
tests.description: Calling update_budget() with no trip should raise RuntimeError

tests.name: test_raises_on_zero_budget
tests.description: Updating with budget of 0 should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_negative_budget
tests.description: Updating with a negative budget should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_string_budget
tests.description: Updating with a string budget should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_boolean_budget
tests.description: Updating with a boolean should raise ValueError

test_classes.description: Verify __str__ content and display_trip() print behaviour

tests.name: test_str_contains_destination
tests.description: __str__ output should include the destination name

tests.name: test_str_contains_start_date
tests.description: __str__ output should include the start date

tests.name: test_str_contains_end_date
tests.description: __str__ output should include the end date

tests.name: test_str_contains_duration
tests.description: __str__ output should include the calculated duration

tests.name: test_str_contains_budget
tests.description: __str__ output should include the formatted budget

tests.name: test_display_trip_prints_output
tests.description: display_trip() should print the destination to stdout

tests.name: test_str_raises_without_trip
tests.description: Calling str() on an empty planner should raise RuntimeError

tests.name: test_display_trip_raises_without_trip
tests.description: Calling display_trip() on an empty planner should raise RuntimeError

test_classes.description: Verify reset_trip() clears state and allows a fresh trip to be added

tests.name: test_clears_all_fields
tests.description: After reset, all four fields should be None

tests.name: test_allows_new_add_trip_after_reset
tests.description: add_trip() should succeed after reset_trip() is called
tests.precondition: Trip added: Paris, France, then reset

tests.name: test_prints_cleared_message
tests.description: reset_trip() should print a message confirming data was cleared

tests.name: test_reset_on_empty_planner_is_safe
tests.description: Calling reset_trip() on a planner with no trip should not raise any exception

test_classes.description: Verify hotel expense calculations for valid and invalid inputs

tests.name: test_default_ratio_hotel_budget
tests.description: 40% of $3500 should return total_hotel_budget of $1400

tests.name: test_default_ratio_remaining_budget
tests.description: Remaining budget should be $3500 - $1400 = $2100

tests.name: test_default_ratio_nights
tests.description: 11-day trip should produce 10 nights

tests.name: test_custom_ratio_hotel_budget
tests.description: 50% of $3500 = $1750 hotel budget

tests.name: test_custom_ratio_remaining_budget
tests.description: Remaining with 50% ratio = $1750

tests.name: test_ratio_of_one_allocates_full_budget
tests.description: ratio=1.0 should allocate entire budget to hotel, remaining=0

tests.name: test_return_type_is_dict
tests.description: Return value should be a dict

tests.name: test_dict_has_required_keys
tests.description: Returned dict must contain all four required keys

tests.name: test_single_day_trip_nights_minimum_one
tests.description: Single-day trip should produce minimum 1 night to avoid division by zero

tests.name: test_raises_without_trip
tests.description: Calling without a trip loaded should raise RuntimeError

tests.name: test_raises_on_zero_ratio
tests.description: hotel_budget_ratio of 0 should raise ValueError (exclusive lower bound)

tests.name: test_raises_on_ratio_above_one
tests.description: hotel_budget_ratio > 1 should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_negative_ratio
tests.description: A negative ratio should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_boolean_ratio
tests.description: A boolean ratio should raise ValueError

tests.name: test_raises_on_string_ratio
tests.description: A string ratio should raise ValueError

test_classes.description: Verify display_hotel_expenses() prints correct formatted output

tests.name: test_prints_hotel_budget
tests.description: Output should contain the formatted hotel budget ($1,400.00)

tests.name: test_prints_nightly_rate
tests.description: Output should contain the nightly rate ($140.00)

tests.name: test_prints_nights
tests.description: Output should contain the number of nights (10)

tests.name: test_prints_remaining_budget
tests.description: Output should contain the remaining budget ($2,100.00)

tests.name: test_prints_total_budget
tests.description: Output should contain the total budget ($3,500.00)

tests.name: test_custom_ratio_reflected_in_output
tests.description: Custom 50% ratio should show '50%' and $1,750.00 hotel budget in output

tests.name: test_raises_without_trip
tests.description: Calling without a trip loaded should raise RuntimeError
